Dublin Bikes — 24-Hour Rebalancing

A large historical station-status archive is reduced with SQL into a small hourly dataset. Move through the day to see where stations tend towards Empty, Balanced or Full — and how that pattern changes between weekdays and weekends.

Selected hour is highlighted on all three series. Click any hour on the chart to jump the map to that time.
Occupancy is the proportion of station capacity represented by available bikes. The three labels are deliberately simple, but the chart and station popups preserve the underlying percentages. This lets the visualisation show the network's daily “seesaw” rather than treating rebalancing as a single morning problem.
